name: Lyssn
one_liner: AI-powered clinical supervision platform that analyzes therapy sessions for fidelity to evidence-based treatments like MI and CBT.
short_description: Lyssn uses AI to analyze recorded therapy sessions and provide objective feedback on therapeutic skills, supporting clinical supervision and quality assurance for evidence-based practices.
long_description: Lyssn is an AI-powered platform designed for clinical supervision and quality assurance in behavioral health. The platform analyzes recorded therapy sessions to assess fidelity to evidence-based treatments including Motivational Interviewing (MI), Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), and other modalities. Lyssn provides objective metrics on therapeutic techniques like reflections, open questions, and empathy. Clinical supervisors use Lyssn to efficiently review supervisee sessions and provide targeted feedback. The platform is used by training programs, community mental health centers, and research institutions. Lyssn emerged from NIH-funded research at the University of Washington.

pricing.notes: Enterprise pricing based on number of clinicians and sessions analyzed.

compliance.notes: HIPAA compliant for analyzing recorded therapy sessions.
